units.rawText: A bartender's best skill is simply the ability to listen.
units.displayText: A bartender's best skill is simply the ability to listen.

spans.text: A bartender's best skill is simply the ability to listen.

units.rawText: Yet when I'm with you, you are the one doing the listening. Whenever I'm around you, I can feel emotions well up inside of me, emotions which I thought I had buried deep down.
units.displayText: Yet when I'm with you, you are the one doing the listening. Whenever I'm around you, I can feel emotions well up inside of me, emotions which I thought I had buried deep down.

units.rawText: Perhaps I should teach you the way to make cocktails? Considering what a great listener you are, I'm sure you will make an excellent bartender.
